introduction: WOOKTOOL replacement utility knife blades support repeat-purchase programs for hardware, retail and professional cutter lines. Buyers should confirm the blade format, compatibility, pack quantity and shelf presentation with the selected knife range.

Include blade size, thickness, material direction, pack quantity, expected order volume, target market and packaging brief in the RFQ. The factory can then review pack presentation, rust-prevention direction and inspection points.

faq.question: What should buyers confirm for replacement utility blades?
faq.answer: Confirm blade format, thickness, compatibility, pack quantity, material, coating or oiling direction, packaging and target market.

faq.question: Can replacement blade packs be private labelled?
faq.answer: Yes. Pack artwork, barcode, carton mark and private-label presentation can be discussed.

faq.question: How are blade packs checked?
faq.answer: Checks can include blade dimensions, cutting-edge appearance, rust prevention, pack quantity, barcode and carton information.

faq.question: Can the packs match an existing utility knife program?
faq.answer: Provide the knife model or blade specification so compatibility can be reviewed before sampling or bulk ordering.
